\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\ef}{\epsilon_F}
\providecommand{\ef}{2\epsilon_F}
\DeclareMathOperator{\sech}{sech}
\begin{document}
Let $x$ be real.
\begin{equation}
\ef + \ef = 2\epsilon_F
\label{eq:p1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\tanh x}{dx} = \sech^2 x
\label{eq:p2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
